summary.text:
Let me evaluate each visual item.

V01: Candidate home page matches reference structure very well: black top bar, IKEA logo, nav, search, category chips (candidate lacks icons on chips but has same labels), hero grid with large left image (same drawer image) and right images. Differences: chip icons missing, right-side images differ (chicken dish instead of kitchen accessories—could be dynamic content exemption), bag icon replaced. Overall very close: 0.75 or 1. The main visual grid structure matches, left image identical, right content differs (dynamic promo exempted). Minor differences: chips lack icons, small icon differences. I'd say 0.75... Actually criteria says dynamic promo content differences exempted. Structure, size, hierarchy match. Minor local differences (chip icons, cart icon). 0.75 seems safe; could argue 1. Key layout correct with only small local differences → 0.75.

V02: Reference menu: wide mega menu with tab pills row (New & trending etc.), left bold links, three columns (Trending/Seasonal/Food), orange promo card, dimmed background. Candidate: no tab pills row, left bold links similar (Explore all products etc.), two columns (Storage & organization, Furniture), product image on right instead of orange promo card. Same state (menu open) with key layout correct but notable differences: missing category pill row, different column content, promo area differs. That's "同状态关键布局正确，仅少量局部差异"? The missing pill row is a meaningful part. Multiple noticeable differences → 0.5? The menu structure (left links + columns + right promo area, dimmed background) is correct. Content differs. I'd say 0.75 minus... The pill row is a significant element missing. I'll give 0.5? Hmm. "可辨认同页面但有多处明显差异或一个重要部分缺失" — missing the category tab row counts as one important part missing → 0.5. Actually columns also differ in density (2 vs 3 columns). I'll go 0.5.

V03: Reference: search results for "besta", left filter sidebar (Sort, Size, Color with swatches, white selected with checkmark), white filter pill, product grid 4 columns, IKEA Family price labels, prices, compare checkboxes. Candidate: very similar — sidebar with Sort/Size/Color, swatches, white pill, product grid, same products/prices. Differences: search suggestions dropdown open (overlay), white swatch lacks checkmark ring, candidate shows rating stars and "Regular price" more prominently, heart icons and cart buttons differ slightly (candidate missing heart/cart on cards? Candidate doesn't show heart icons and blue cart buttons on cards). Reference has heart icons + blue cart buttons on cards; candidate lacks those. Also dropdown overlay. Still clearly same state, key layout correct, some local differences → 0.75. The open search suggestion dropdown is a state artifact. Missing cart/heart buttons on cards is a local difference. 0.75.

V04: Reference compare: "Product comparison" heading, two product columns with images, close X, hearts, IKEA Family price, BESTÅ, prices with decimals style $55.00, discount lines, regular price, validity text, star ratings, Key features with Width rows. Candidate: same heading, two columns, same images/products, prices, ratings, Key features with Width/Height/Depth rows. Differences: search suggestions dropdown overlapping top, missing hearts/cart buttons, missing discount/validity text lines, candidate shows more attribute rows visible. Key layout correct, local differences → 0.75. Missing the promotional text lines is a minor local difference. The dropdown overlay partially obscures. 0.75.
